title: Thieving Fox
description: Turns the common Fox into a Thieving Fox, as they often pick up dropped items.
body:
This pack turns the common Minecraft Fox into a Thieving Fox, as they often pick up dropped items.


What I changed in this texture:


Thief Beanie: It is a beanie that gives the look that she is a thief, covering the face to match the thieving fox style.

Thief Gloves: Dark gloves on the paws to match the thief gloves look and the character's personality.

16x Resolution: Native Minecraft resolution to ensure the best performance and more FPS on any computer.
